title: TCL BeyondTV2, Latin America / Brazil market (ro.product.model BeyondTV2, brand TCL), Android TV 9
header:
TCL BeyondTV2, Latin America / Brazil market (ro.product.model BeyondTV2, brand TCL), Android TV 9
(API 28), build PPR1.180610.011, security patch 2021-01-05. Realtek RTD2851 family
(ro.board.platform = rtd285o), firmware V8-R851T02-LF1V660, client TCL-LA-RT2851-S1.
Fingerprint: TCL/BeyondTV2/BeyondTV:9/PPR1.180610.011/AP08:user/release-keys
2 GB RAM with 800 MB zRAM, 32-bit userspace, eMMC with 10 GB /data. Latin America set
(TCL app store, no India Jio/Airtel/Hotstar; a set of UK Freeview catch-up apps is preloaded
and was already disabled at the factory).

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/tcl-beyondtv2-latin-america/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/tcl-beyondtv2-latin-america/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher (restore.sh / build-and-install.sh defaults work).
Live TV app: com.tcl.tv, with com.tcl.tvinput for the tuner and HDMI 1-3.
This is a different set from examples/tcl-beyondtv (India market): same build number
PPR1.180610.011, different product name and different region, so the preloaded app set and the
factory-disabled set differ.

Tested: applied on a real unit on 2026-10-18/19. Each package was disabled on its own, the
device rebooted, and a 24-check smoke test (HDMI input, Live TV session, Netflix, Assistant,
microphone, Bluetooth remote, audio output, no crashes) passed after every change.
I have NOT lived with this list for days yet, and the file header says so.
Measured effect: these two packages removed processes but gave NO measurable overall speed gain
(idle CPU and app-open times stayed within run-to-run noise). They are kept for less telemetry,
not for speed.

Already disabled at the factory on this firmware: com.tcl.bootadservice, com.tcl.gallery,
au.com.stan.and, com.amazon.amazonvideo.livingroom, com.linecorp.linetv, tv.wuaki.apptv and
the 14 uk.co.freeview.* catch-up apps.

DO NOT DISABLE (load-bearing): com.tcl.tv com.tcl.tvinput com.tcl.sourcemananger (Live TV,
HDMI, tuner, Source menu), com.tcl.autopair com.tcl.tcl_bt_rcu_service
com.tcl.keycustomfunctionservice (remote, BT pairing, FallbackHome), com.tcl.framework.custom
com.tcl.keyhelp com.tcl.partnercustomizer (key handling, TKey activity),
com.tcl.inputmethod.international com.tcl.settings com.tcl.initsetup com.tcl.factory.view
com.tcl.common.terminalmanagerplus com.tcl.xian.StartandroidService com.tcl.appstatecontroller
com.tcl.copydatatotv com.android.ListenNetStateService (unclear roles, boot/package/network
hooks), com.realtek.netflix.setting (Netflix ESN/config), com.tcl.usercenter
com.tcl.useragreement (setup screens), com.google.android.katniss com.google.android.speech.pumpkin
com.tcl.assistant com.tcl.micmanager (voice), com.google.android.apps.mediashell (Chromecast),
com.tcl.versionUpdateApp com.tcl.rc.ota (firmware updates).
